plugins.name: 6x6 General Spring for Pile Foundation (KR)
plugins.purpose: Computes pile-foundation stiffness by the Korean Highway Bridge Design Code (2010) displacement method and imports the combined directional matrices into Civil as a 6x6 General Spring.
key_inputs: Pile Information (pile type: cast-in-place / PHC / SC / steel pipe / soil cement, construction method, single / group / composite upper-lower pile, reinforcing section, pile layout coordinates)
Ground Information (soil layer type clay / sand / gravel, shear wave velocity, horizontal subgrade reaction coefficient KH reduction for liquefaction, slope and group-pile effects)
Import Data Type1 / Type2 (mapping of the plugin load coordinate system to the Civil coordinate system)
plugins.notes: Doc cross-links no JSON API endpoint, so the General Spring write target is unconfirmed. Core is deterministic engineering computation (pile characteristic values, Kv, K1-K4, 6x6 matrix, Excel calculation sheet) plus a model write; a REST re-implementation needs the spring endpoint identified first.

plugins.name: Alignment Editor
plugins.purpose: Transforms bridge model node geometry from an initial alignment to a target alignment and automatically updates the beta angles of vertical elements so local axes stay consistent.
key_inputs: Initial Points (X/Y/Z, or Import Coordinates from selected model nodes)
plugins.notes: Doc cross-links no endpoint; node-coordinate and beta-angle writes must be mapped. The interpolation and rigid-rotation remapping are pure computation (scipy CubicSpline / Akima1DInterpolator / PchipInterpolator are referenced by the original), and both point tables need at least 2 rows with ascending X.

plugins.name: Alignment Local Axis for Element
plugins.purpose: Aligns plate-element local z axes toward a user-supplied reference point, reversing the plate orientation when the angle between the normal and the reference vector exceeds 90 degrees.
key_inputs: Reference Point (coordinates of the node the local z axis should point at)
plugins.notes: Doc cross-links no endpoint; the element local-axis write must be mapped. The algorithm itself is a simple normal-vector versus reference-vector angle test and is fully computational; useful for cylindrical structures.

plugins.name: Alignment Generator
plugins.purpose: Generates complex horizontal alignments (arc, clothoid, cubic parabola) as nodes, elements and local axes directly inside Civil NX, replacing CAD-based preparation.
key_inputs: Segment list with Line Type and length / start and end radius
Structure Group / Material / Section ID per segment
plugins.notes: Doc cross-links no endpoint; node / element / local-axis creation endpoints must be mapped. Spiral math (clothoid, cubic parabola) is pure computation. Operates in the X-Y plane only, the base node is GCS (0,0,0) with node numbers increasing in +X, and sections and materials must exist before running.

plugins.name: Artificial Earthquake Generator
plugins.purpose: Generates ASCE7-22 design and MCEr response spectra from the USGS Seismic Design Geodatabase and spectrum-matched artificial ground motions for time-history analysis.
key_inputs: Target Address (By Address) or By Latitude/Longitude
Risk Category, Soil Site Class, Design Spectrum Option
Spectrum data type (Two-Period / Multi-Period, Design / MCEr)
Artificial earthquake Rise, Level, Total time, Damping Ratio, max acceleration, Envelope Function data
plugins.notes: Spectrum computation and spectral matching are deterministic and both write endpoints (/db/SPFC, /db/THFC) are cross-linked by the doc. Depends on the external USGS Seismic Design Geodatabase for the base hazard data.

plugins.name: Artificial Earthquake Correlation Checker
plugins.purpose: Computes the correlation coefficients between artificial earthquake Time History Functions and flags pairs whose coefficient exceeds the KDS limit (default 0.16).
key_inputs: Time History Functions (selected from the loaded list, Refresh)
plugins.notes: Read-only computation over /db/THFC data with no model writes; results are shown in a table with blue/red highlighting and 'NG' where the functions have unequal data counts. Correlation is computed per KDS 17 10 00.

plugins.name: [AS/NZS 1170.2:2021] Building Wind Loads Generator
plugins.purpose: Computes static wind loads on enclosed buildings to AS/NZS 1170.2:2021 (Australian clauses only) and applies height-varying story forces to the structural model.
key_inputs: C_shp / C_pe (external pressure coefficient by h/d)
Building plan dimensions b x d
Wind Load Input Condition (Input Only Worst-Case Value)
plugins.notes: Code computation (p = p_air x V_des^2 x C_shp x C_dyn, p_air = 1.2 kg/m3) plus a /db/SWIND write, with Excel calculation sheet export and story force / shear / overturning moment charts. The doc warns the linked endpoint is documented for KDS 41-12:2022 / User Type, so AS/NZS field mapping is unconfirmed. Flexible tall buildings are unsupported and all K factors are assumed 1.0.

plugins.name: [AS 1170.4:2024] Static Seismic Loads Generator
plugins.purpose: Computes equivalent static seismic loads to AS 1170.4:2024 for EDC I and II structures and applies the X and Y story force distributions to selected static load cases.
key_inputs: Sub-Soil Class (Ae, Be, Ce, De, Ee)
kp x Z verification against Table 3.3 minimum
Fundamental Period T1 (manual entry or Period Calculator)
Load Cases to Apply to Seismic Loads
plugins.notes: Code computation (base shear per Eq. 5.3 for EDC I and Eq. 6.2(3) for EDC II) plus /db/STLD and /db/SSEIS writes; the doc flags AS 1170.4 field mapping on /db/SSEIS (documented for KDS 41-17-00:2019 / User Type) as unconfirmed. EDC III (dynamic analysis), Importance Level 1 and domestic structures are out of scope.

plugins.name: Assign Floor Loads
plugins.purpose: Assigns floor loads in bulk to areas bounded by user-selected members, with graphical and tabular confirmation of which areas succeeded or failed.
plugins.notes: Static floor-load assignment (no dedicated enum category for static loads; recorded as other). The /db/FBLA write is cross-linked, but the workflow relies on dragging members in the model view and on graphical plus node-number verification of applied / failed areas. Always runs with 'Allow Polygon Type Unit Area' on; 'Unmodeled Sub-Beam' and 'Convert to Beam Load types' are unsupported.

plugins.name: Auto Saver
plugins.purpose: Automatically saves the working model file at a user-defined interval (default 5 minutes) to prevent data loss.
plugins.notes: Desktop-session utility tied to the running GUI application and local file saving; no engineering computation and no model data semantics, so it is not meaningfully re-implementable over REST. Doc cross-links no endpoint.

plugins.name: Breakdown Load Combination
plugins.purpose: Decomposes a complex load combination into combinations of Civil's primary load cases for chosen elements, element ends, force/moment components and envelope type.
key_inputs: Load combination to break down (Import Load Combinations)
plugins.notes: Must run post-analysis in 'PostCS' / 'locked' state and requires model-view element selection (max 5). Decomposed load combination names are limited to 20 characters; Active must be Strength/Stress, Serviceability or Active and Type must be Add or Envelope; South Africa and France moving loads are unsupported and asymmetric cases (moving, settlement) allow positive factors only. The doc does not state which design-group LCOM endpoint is used.

plugins.name: Concrete Material Set EN1992-1-1
plugins.purpose: Computes EN 1992-1-1 concrete material properties and time-dependent behaviour (creep coefficients, shrinkage strain, mean strengths, elastic modulus, stress-strain curves) with graphs for verification.
key_inputs: Time-Dependent display items (creep coefficients, shrinkage strain, mean compressive strength, mean tensile strength, elastic modulus)
plugins.notes: Pure code-based calculator: the doc explicitly states the computed time-dependent properties are NOT written into the model and must be entered manually, so no /db write is required. EN 1992-2 is selectable for input storage only with no calculation; the doc cross-links no endpoint.

plugins.name: Concurrent Force Calculator
plugins.purpose: Extracts concurrent internal forces (FX, FY, FZ, MX, MY, MZ) for selected elements and load combinations and exports the tabulated results directly to Excel.
key_inputs: Force components FX / FY / FZ / MX / MY / MZ
Excel target (new worksheet or update existing)
plugins.notes: Read-only post-processing plus Excel output; requires a completed analysis and processes only the selected elements. Doc cross-links no endpoint (the result tables are the data source and Excel is the destination).

plugins.name: Convert Load Combination into SDS Format
plugins.purpose: Converts existing load combinations into combinations of primary load cases only, so they can be used in MIDAS SDS.
key_inputs: Select lcb Type (design type to import)
Select Active Type (type to convert into SDS LCB type)
Delivery method: clipboard or Excel download
plugins.notes: The doc states SDS has no active API, so the handoff is clipboard or Excel file only — the destination program is outside REST. The decomposition logic itself is computational. Doc cross-links no endpoint.

plugins.name: Customized Load Combination
plugins.purpose: Generates standard or custom design load combinations (optionally with auto envelopes and wizard-file import/export) into the Steel, Concrete, SRC and Composite Steel Girder design combination tables.
key_inputs: Load Case name, Sign (+ / - / +- / +,-) and up to 5 factors
Generate Load Combinations In (Steel / Concrete / SRC / Composite Steel Girder Design)
Export / Import Load Combination Input (wizard file)
plugins.notes: Deterministic combination expansion plus writes to all four design-group LCOM endpoints, each cross-linked by the doc. Sign permutations (+, -, +-, +,-) and multi-factor slots are the main logic; the wizard file is a reusable input library.

plugins.name: CS Report Generator
plugins.purpose: Extracts the activation / deactivation state of structure, boundary and load groups across all construction stages into a single downloadable Excel report.
plugins.notes: Explicitly a read-only verification and reporting utility — the doc states it does not modify model data, construction stages or activation settings. The /db/STAG read is cross-linked and the output is .xlsx.

plugins.name: Dynamic Analysis of Rail Bridge
plugins.purpose: Generates the time-history load cases for a train speed sweep, applies EN1991-2:2003 Clause 6.4.6.3(2) default damping, and reports maximum vertical acceleration versus speed with Excel export.
key_inputs: Initial Speed, Final Speed, Speed Increment
Bridge Type for Damping (or user-defined damping)
Train Load File (Excel: serial number, axle load, axle spacing)
plugins.notes: Load-case generation is computational and /db/THIS is cross-linked, but the workflow depends on repeated proprietary time-history solver runs and on node-group selection for the track path and acceleration output. Modelling condition to verify before analysis: x1 + x2 > d_min for any two consecutive bridge elements versus the minimum train axle spacing.

plugins.name: Easy Capture Generator
plugins.purpose: Stores print / capture settings (DB, display type, view, load cases) as reusable JSON and produces multi-view printed output.
key_inputs: View options with Active All / Active by Node-Element / Active Identity
plugins.notes: The /view/* endpoints are cross-linked, but the deliverable is a rendered view / print output tied to GUI display state and desktop printing, not a data structure. The landing page also lists this article under the alias 'Image Capture Generator' (same URL).

plugins.name: Easy Load Combinations
plugins.purpose: Builds load combinations from automatically imported model load cases by applying user-entered factors and sends them to Civil NX in one click.
plugins.notes: Simple combination construction plus a /db/LCOM-GEN write, with the endpoint cross-linked. Load cases must match the Civil NX model; Eurocode moving loads require v1.1.0 or later.

plugins.name: Element Information
plugins.purpose: Displays detailed properties of selected elements (type, material, section, connected nodes, length / area / volume, unit and total weight, beam end release) without opening element tables.
plugins.notes: Read-only viewer over /db/ELEM with no model modification. Reported types are BEAM, TRUSS, TENSTR, COMPTR, PLATE, WALL, PLSTRS, PLSTRN, AXISYM, SOLID; BER values are '-', F (fixed) or P (pinned).

plugins.name: [Eurocode] Fatigue Analysis for Composite Girder Bridge
plugins.purpose: Performs Eurocode fatigue assessment (with Italian NTC 2018 national annex) of concrete, reinforcing steel and steel girders in composite bridges using stresses and forces imported from Civil NX.
key_inputs: Partial safety factor gamma and design life (years or cycles)
Load cases and construction stages to import results from
Per-case section / material data (L, d, fck, bw, Qn, J, Vrd,c, d, section properties)
Correction factors lambda (auto or manual override)
plugins.notes: The code-check arithmetic is self-contained once stresses and forces are read, but the doc cross-links no endpoint and the workflow depends on importing selected element results and on MIDAS NX 'Analysis / Main Control Data / Calculate Equivalent Beam Stresses' being enabled. The steel girder shear case accepts static load cases only, so moving loads must be converted to static first; inputs failing validity checks (e.g. non-positive compressive stress) are excluded from assessment.

plugins.name: Flared Pier
plugins.purpose: Generates flared pier geometry from predefined sections and materials along the pier local axis, needing only the top node level to define the column ends.
plugins.notes: Doc cross-links no endpoint; node / element generation endpoints must be mapped. All selected nodes must share the same local axis or generation errors out, all inputs must be greater than zero, and Refresh is required after model changes.

plugins.name: Floor Transition
plugins.purpose: Moves or copies a modelled floor's nodes and elements to another floor, using story data when available and Z coordinates otherwise.
key_inputs: Criteria Node (one node on the source floor)
plugins.notes: Node and element coordinate translation is deterministic and /db/STOR is cross-linked as the story reference. When no story data exists the plugin falls back to Z-coordinate ordering of node groups.

plugins.name: GEN NX to Staad Converter
plugins.purpose: Converts a MIDAS GEN NX model (geometry, materials, sections, supports, releases, loads and load combinations) into a STAAD.Pro .std file while logging every mapping and unsupported item.
key_inputs: Export data checkboxes: Geometry, Material Properties, Section Properties, Supports, Loads, Load Combinations
plugins.notes: Read-only export into a documented text format with no proprietary solver involved, and the doc supplies full mapping tables. Explicitly unsupported: orthotropic and SRC materials; VALUE / SRC / COMBINED / TAPERED / COMPOSITE sections; nonlinear point springs and spring damping; beam load eccentricity; trapezoidal pressure loads with projection; envelope combinations; floor diaphragms; beam end offsets; section stiffness scale factors; load to masses; static seismic and static wind loads. FBLA floor loads must be converted to beam loads in MIDAS first. Doc cross-links no endpoint.

plugins.name: Group Pile
plugins.purpose: Generates a group pile with an optional pile cap from model sections and materials using a parametric pile array definition.
key_inputs: Structural Group, Boundary Group, Pile Material, Pile Section, Pile Cap Material and Section (optional)
Pile array numbers, centre-to-centre spacing, edge length, pile diameter, length (unit D or L), cap height (optional)
plugins.notes: Doc cross-links no endpoint; node / element generation endpoints must be mapped. All selected nodes must share one local axis for correct pile alignment and all numeric inputs (spacing, depth) must be greater than zero.

plugins.name: Inertial Forces Controller
plugins.purpose: Rotates horizontal inertial (nodal body) forces to user-specified angles for curved-bridge piers and creates the corresponding static and time-history load cases, functions and time-varying static loads.
key_inputs: Time History Load Cases (Analysis Method = Static)
Static Load case containing Nodal Body Force and Nodal Loads
Time History Functions (Normal type; preset Linear)
Horizontal load angle(s) about the global Z axis (multiple allowed)
plugins.notes: Coordinate transformation of nodal body forces plus writes to all five cross-linked endpoints. Scale factor must be greater than zero and angles cannot repeat; generated body forces are named 'Static Load name_angle deg'.

plugins.name: Iterative Response Spectrum
plugins.purpose: Repeatedly runs response-spectrum analysis, updating point-spring secant stiffnesses from displacements until a user tolerance is met, to capture soil-structure interaction.
plugins.notes: Requires repeated proprietary response-spectrum solver runs between stiffness updates, so it cannot be reduced to a single REST call. Documented assumptions: symmetric force-deformation functions with no negative slope; minimum stiffness 0.001 for translational DOF in directions without a multi-linear definition; force held constant beyond the defined deformation range; node local axes used for secant stiffness when defined; construction-stage scoping (Default group parameters excluded). The point-spring endpoint is not identified in the doc.

plugins.name: Line to Plate Converter
plugins.purpose: Converts selected beam elements into plate-element meshes matched to the original section shape, material and stiffness, with optional rigid links at the span ends.
key_inputs: Division Type toggle (OFF: mesh division count 2-500 default 5; ON: mesh size 0.1-10.0 m default 0.50 m)
Section Mesh size (0.1-10.0 m, default 0.50 m)
plugins.notes: Geometry generation plus /db/ELEM and /db/RIGD writes, both cross-linked. The plugin deletes the source 1D elements together with associated loads and tendons, which must then be recreated manually. Supported uniform and tapered shapes: L, C, H, T, B, P, SB, 1-CEL, 2-CEL; only the continuous chain starting from the lowest element ID is processed.

plugins.name: Load Effect for Load Combination
plugins.purpose: Extracts the beam force of each load case contained in a selected load combination and shows its unfactored value, factor and factored value so the contribution of each case can be inspected.
key_inputs: Elements imported from the model view (Import)
Sort by Absolute / Sort by Max-Min
plugins.notes: Read-only post-processing; the doc cross-links /db/LCOM-GEN and the POST 8. Beam Force endpoint. The most unfavourable value is shown red and the least influential blue; moving load cases can appear simultaneously as max and min.

plugins.name: Local Axis
plugins.purpose: Computes tangential node local axes along a cubic spline through selected nodes and applies the rotated values directly to the model.
key_inputs: Nodes to receive the local axis (Import Node)
Start Point and End Point (Clamped Cubic Spline only)
plugins.notes: Spline tangent computation plus a /db/SKEW write, cross-linked by the doc. Only X-Y plane information is imported, the spline is generated in the +X direction only, and nodes must be brought in through the Import Node button.

plugins.name: Mirror Tapered Section
plugins.purpose: Creates a mirrored tapered section by swapping the I and J ends of an existing tapered section, giving a symmetric section with the same local axis.
plugins.notes: Pure section-data transformation plus a /db/SECT write, cross-linked by the doc. Applies to Tapered Value, User and DB sections only; used for symmetric coping pairs such as coping 1-1 / coping 1-2.

plugins.name: [MS 1553:2002] Building Wind Loads Generator
plugins.purpose: Computes static wind loads on Malaysian building structures to MS 1553:2002 and applies directional story forces to selected static load cases.
key_inputs: V_s (basic wind speed, Zone I 33.5 m/s, Zone II 32.5 m/s)
Building plan dimensions b x d
X-Dir / Y-Dir tabs and target static load cases
plugins.notes: Code computation (p = 0.5 x p_air x V_des^2 x C_fig x C_dyn, p_air = 1.225 kg/m3, so 0.5 x p_air = 0.613) plus a /db/SWIND write with Excel export. The doc flags the linked endpoint as documented for KDS 41-12:2022 / User Type, so MS 1553 field mapping is unconfirmed. Flexible tall buildings are unsupported; the original numbering repeats M_z,cat as items 3 and 4.

plugins.name: Nastran Importer
plugins.purpose: Imports Nastran BDF (Bulk Data Format) files into Civil NX, converting node and element data while preserving mesh structure.
plugins.notes: File parsing plus node / element creation; only nodes and elements are supported and unsupported data (e.g. solver-specific commands) is silently ignored. Mesh continuity should be verified after import. Doc cross-links no endpoint.

plugins.name: Node Controller
plugins.purpose: Creates or translates selected node coordinates with tabular display and direct table editing, without navigating node tables.
key_inputs: X, Y, Z movement distance values
plugins.notes: Coordinate editing plus a /db/NODE write, cross-linked by the doc. Units follow the model's selected length unit; nodes with differing coordinates on an axis are shown as 'Var.' and blocked from bulk editing.

plugins.name: P-Y Curve Generator
plugins.purpose: Generates depth-varying nonlinear P-Y soil springs for pile foundations from API RP2A, Matlock (1970), Reese et al. and rock models, and writes them into the model as nonlinear boundary conditions.
key_inputs: Ground layer profile (layer types, unit weights, automatic groundwater level)
Ground level and water table elevation
Pile geometry (import from MIDAS product, pile group rotation angle)
Group Effect Calculator p-multipliers (X and Y independent, manual or calculated)
Pile-Soil Assignment (pile info, ground profile, pile shift)
plugins.notes: Empirical / code P-Y formulation with equivalent-depth (Georgiadis) layer-transition integration, influence-zone spring assembly and equivalent-diameter conversion for non-circular sections, plus /db boundary writes; the doc marks both linked endpoints as unconfirmed ('대응 미확인'). Supported pile types: Pipe, Solid Round, H-Section, Box, Solid Rectangle. Includes a verification chapter comparing results against reference programs and hand calculations (e.g. P = -1607.42 kN at 9.0-10.0 m depth for a 15.0 m x 1.20 m pile).

plugins.name: Rebar Auto Generator
plugins.purpose: Automatically generates longitudinal and shear reinforcement at predefined standard positions for PSC-composite sections to the Australian RMS standard.
plugins.notes: Section reinforcement generation plus a /db/RPSC write, cross-linked by the doc. Only the AS-Super-T_RMS_2019 section is currently supported, the plugin auto-detects PSC-composite sections, and running it overwrites existing rebar data on the selected section. The original 'Benefits' paragraph is copied from another plugin article and was not carried over.

plugins.name: Rebar Spacing Converter
plugins.purpose: Converts rebar size and spacing combinations at equal steel area (for example #4@100 into #3+#4@77.5) across national rebar standards.
key_inputs: National rebar standard (ASTM, KS, EN, GB, IS, JIS, UNI, AS/NZS)
plugins.notes: Pure arithmetic over a rebar database with a running results list; no model reads or writes and no endpoint cross-linked. Supports single-rebar and two-rebar (alternating) input methods, plus a spacing verification view.

plugins.name: Response Spectrum Generator
plugins.developed_with: MIDAS CIVIL NX 2025 (v1.1) US, MIDAS GEN NX 2025 (v1.1) US
plugins.purpose: Generates code-based design response spectrum functions from user-specified seismic parameters and assigns them for dynamic analysis.
plugins.notes: Code spectrum computation plus a /db/SPFC write, cross-linked by the doc. The article is internally contradictory on code coverage: it lists seven codes (NZS 1170.5:2004, AS 1170.4:2024, SBC 301-CR:2018, NF EN1998-1:2008, UNE EN1998-1:2011, SNZ TS 1170.5:2025, Peru E.030:2026) while its Note states only NZS 1170.5 (2004) is supported. All inputs must be valid positive decimals.

plugins.name: Rigid Link Generator
plugins.purpose: Creates rigid links from each selected master node to the nearest node of a selected slave node group, without specifying distances or exact slave nodes.
plugins.notes: Nearest-node search plus a /db/RIGD write, cross-linked by the doc. Mainly used for connecting frame elements (girders) to plate elements (slabs) in superstructure models.

plugins.name: Seismic Hazard Map
plugins.purpose: Looks up the KDS 17 10 00:2024 national seismic hazard map value for a site address or latitude/longitude across selected return periods.
plugins.notes: Needs the national seismic hazard map dataset plus bilinear interpolation; the doc explicitly states the returned values are still estimates. No model read or write and no endpoint cross-linked. Applicable checks: effective ground acceleration S = seismic zone coefficient x risk factor, with S not less than 80% of that value.

plugins.name: Series Load
plugins.purpose: Applies a series of custom static beam loads (concentrated, distributed, impact, centrifugal) at regular intervals along continuous spline-aligned structures.
key_inputs: Distance between load cases (number of static load cases)
plugins.notes: Static load-series generation (no dedicated enum category for static loads; recorded as other) plus /db/STLD and /db/BMLD writes, both cross-linked. Requires continuous, non-disjointed elements; centrifugal force direction is derived from the connected node spline tangent (Monotone Cubic Hermite Spline recommended); all load magnitudes must be greater than zero.

plugins.name: SPACE GASS Converter
plugins.purpose: Imports SPACE GASS .txt model data (materials, sections, nodes, elements, boundary conditions, loads) into Civil NX with explicit coordinate-system remapping.
plugins.notes: Text-file parsing plus model creation; the doc gives full mapping tables including the axis transform (SPACE GASS X to Civil X, Y to Z, Z to -Y), element mapping (Normal to General Beam, Plate to Plate, Tension Only, Compression Only), boundary conditions (SUPPORT, POINT SPRING, RIGID LINK / ELASTIC LINK, BEAM END RELEASE) and load case mapping. Only .txt SPACE GASS files are accepted. Doc cross-links no endpoint.

plugins.name: Stiffness Auto Tuner
plugins.purpose: Iteratively runs analysis and design checks, updating beam Element Stiffness Factors and wall stiffness factors until member check ratios satisfy a user-defined target ratio.
key_inputs: Target members via Sync from product
Bulk selection by Section or Wall ID
Stiffness decrement sequence (Value to insert / Value to delete)
plugins.notes: Requires repeated proprietary analysis runs plus KDS 41 20 2022 RC design check results (Beam Check for beams, Wall Design for walls) between stiffness updates. Beam Element Stiffness Factor maps to the cross-linked /db/ESSF; the wall stiffness factor endpoint is not identified in the doc. Final stiffness values are written back as auto-generated element groups named e.g. 'AutoTuner_Beam [0.80] [Node=0; Element=4]'.

plugins.name: Substructure Generator
plugins.purpose: Generates a complete, ready-to-analyse 3D bridge substructure model (pier cap, pier, footing or pile foundation, bearings and applied loads) together with a downloadable Excel report containing captured result screenshots.
key_inputs: Initial Data (start coordinates, pier cap / pier / footing materials)
Pier & Pier Cap (dimensions, shape circular or rectangular, element mesh length)
Foundation (open or pile: dimensions, depth, mesh size, SBC, ground properties)
Bearing (arrangement both sides or centre, distance, pedestal height, elastic link stiffness)
Moving Load (max vertical, longitudinal, transverse reactions)
Dynamic Load (wind parameters, seismic data with IS 1893 response spectrum)
Download / Upload JSON of all inputs
plugins.notes: Model generation and response-spectrum function creation are computational and /db/SPFC is cross-linked, but the Excel report embeds screenshots captured from Civil NX (BMD, displacement contours, section views) and the static / moving / wind / seismic write endpoints are not identified in the doc. Report images require Civil NX Display Option (Alt+E) Draw > Hidden Option (Model) > Plane Thickness enabled.

plugins.name: [TAIWAN2014] Building Wind Loads Generator
plugins.purpose: Computes static wind loads on enclosed buildings to the Taiwan 2014 building wind code (K(z), Kzt, gust effect factor, Cpe) and applies story forces to selected static load cases.
key_inputs: Exposure Category A / B / C (alpha, Zg, Zmin)
Mean Roof Height hn (auto-extracted from storey data)
Topographic Factor Kzt (Hill Shape Ridge/Escarpment/Hill, Hill Height H, Hill Length Lh, Crest-Building Distance x)
Structure Type (Rigid or Flexible, with frequency and damping ratio)
Gust Effect Factor G or Gf via calculator
Building Width and Depth b x d
Load Cases to Apply to Wind Loads (X and Y must differ)
plugins.notes: Complete documented calculation flow (K(z), Kzt, gust factor, Cpe windward 0.8 and leeward by L/B, GCpi 0.375, story force / shear / overturning moment) plus a /db/SWIND write; the doc flags the linked endpoint as documented for KDS 41-12:2022 / User Type, so TAIWAN 2014 field mapping is unconfirmed. z is treated as 5 m when z <= 5 m.

plugins.name: Temperature Gradient Stress Generator
plugins.purpose: Computes AASHTO-LRFD self-equilibrating stresses from temperature gradients for PSC, concrete and steel-composite sections and adds heating / cooling temperature loads to selected elements.
key_inputs: T3 option at the bottom of the section
plugins.notes: Section-based computation plus a /db/BTMP write, cross-linked by the doc. The distinguishing feature versus the built-in Temp. Gradient function is that the plugin shows self-equilibrating stresses in a stress summary table with non-linear gradient and stress charts. The original Conclusion paragraph is copied from the Inertial Forces Controller article and was not carried over.

plugins.name: Temperature Load Calculator for Bridges (HK)
plugins.purpose: Calculates uniform temperature change and temperature difference thermal actions for bridges to HK SDM 2013 Section 3.5 and applies them as element temperature loads.
key_inputs: Adjustment to Temperature method (Ceiling Method or Linear Interpolation)
Load cases for expansion / contraction and heating / cooling
plugins.notes: Code calculation plus /db/ETMP and /db/BTMP writes, both cross-linked by the doc. Load cases must be identical and predefined, and loads are applied as relative values against the Civil initial temperature. Temperature differences apply to beam elements only, with listed supported section types (USER H/B, COMPOSITE B/I/Tub/GB/GI/GT, PSC cells and shapes) and minimum section heights (Type 1 600 mm, Type 2 slab height + 400 mm, Type 3 135 mm).

plugins.name: Tendon Profile
plugins.purpose: Converts element tendon profiles from relative to absolute coordinates (element profile to straight profile) with configurable X direction, rotation angle and Y/Z offsets.
key_inputs: X-axis direction, rotation angle, Y/Z offsets
plugins.notes: Coordinate transformation plus a /db/TDNA write, cross-linked by the doc. Works with 2D/3D and Splice / Element input types; Straight Length and Transfer Length are unsupported in both, and Fix / BOT are additionally unsupported for 2D input. The NEW button creates a profile named after the original with a '_str' suffix.

plugins.name: Traffic Lane Generator
plugins.purpose: Creates multiple traffic lanes at once on a selected reference element across 15 moving load codes, with per-lane eccentricities.
key_inputs: Reference element selected in Civil NX
Wheel spacing, lane width, span length, impact factor, vehicle load distribution
Lane Configuration table (add / delete lanes L1, L2, L3, eccentricity per lane)
plugins.notes: Moving-load lane generation (no dedicated enum category for moving loads; recorded as other) plus a /db/LLAN write, cross-linked by the doc. Plugin input fields mirror the Civil NX UI.

plugins.name: Thailand DPT Code Auto Searching
plugins.purpose: Looks up Thailand DPT design parameters by province and district on a map: seismic (Seismic Zone, Ss, S1) and wind (Wind Zone, Wind Speed, Typhoon Factor).
plugins.notes: Requires the Thailand DPT parameter dataset plus a map UI; purely a reference lookup with no model read or write and no endpoint cross-linked. Serves both seismic and wind parameter selection, so it is recorded as utility rather than a single load category.

plugins.name: Tunnel Lining Generator
plugins.purpose: Builds a tunnel lining analysis model from DXF-imported centreline elements by creating nodes 1 m outward and connecting them with compression-only elastic links whose stiffness comes from the subgrade modulus.
key_inputs: Subgrade Modulus and Poisson's ratio (AFTES formula)
plugins.notes: Geometry plus spring-stiffness computation and /db/NODE and /db/ELNK writes, both cross-linked. The end spring condition requires sections assigned to the elements (spring stiffness is computed from element width); without an assigned section the end condition must be Hinge. Applies AFTES and U.S. formulas per the Korea Expressway Corporation (2016) concrete lining design criteria.

plugins.name: Wind Load Calculator for Bridges (HK)
plugins.purpose: Calculates peak velocity pressure and wind-induced forces on bridges to HK SDM 2013 Section 3.4 using the Simplified or Full Procedure and applies them to selected beam elements.
key_inputs: Load case name for the wind load
Velocity Pressure Case (Simplified Clause 3.4.2 or Full Clause 3.4.3)
Force Coefficient (or BS EN based automatic calculation)
Restraint Height (parapet / barrier not in the model)
plugins.notes: Code calculation plus /db/STLD and /db/SWIND writes, both cross-linked, with the doc flagging SDM 2013 field mapping on /db/SWIND as unconfirmed. Tables 3.6 (Wind Velocities), 3.7 (Peak Velocity Pressure) and 3.8 (Exposure to Wind) drive the automatic calculation. The Full Procedure is mandatory for spans over 100 m, strategic routes or bridges over 40 m above ground; the Clause 3.4.4 Dynamic Response Procedure is out of scope.

plugins.name: Floor Load Table Generator
plugins.purpose: Manages gravity dead / live floor loads by room and space category and both exports a report-ready load table PDF and writes the loads into the analysis model.
key_inputs: Global Setting (project name, DL/LL factors, DL/LL load case mapping, company logo)
Load Group (Name, Type thickness or load, Thickness mm, Unit Weight kN/m3, Load kN/m2)
plugins.notes: Deprecated: the original article was removed from the official site (404 confirmed 2026-08-30) and the local document is retained for historical record only. Load computation plus /db/FBLD and /db/FBLA writes with /db/STLD as the case mapping target, all cross-linked. Live load is normally entered manually; the original text mislabels the saved settings file as .pdf when it is actually JSON.

plugins.name: Easy Result Table
plugins.purpose: Collects selected post-processing result tables (reaction, story drift, overturning moment and similar) into a single report-ready PDF in one pass.
key_inputs: Settings panel (storey range, units, sort order) with Save
plugins.notes: Deprecated: the original article was removed from the official site (404 confirmed 2026-08-30) and the local document is retained for historical record only. Read-only result retrieval plus PDF rendering; the doc cross-links /post/table result tables and the Story Tables chapter. Supported tables include Reaction Force/Moments, Vibration Mode Shape, Story Drift, Story Displacement, Story Shear, Story Eccentricity, Story Shear Force Ratio, Stability Coefficient, Weight Irregularity Check, Overturning Moment, Story Axial Force Sum, Torsional Amplification Factor, Stiffness Irregularity Check and Capacity Irregularity Check.

plugins.name: Bulk Tabular Result Exporter
plugins.purpose: Exports any set of pre-processing model tables and post-processing result tables into a single structured Excel workbook with one worksheet per defined Job.
key_inputs: Table Jobs selected from the catalog (or Any DB Table / Any Result Table)
Result components, node / element ID and numeric range filters, Structure Group
Load case and load combination suffixes
Units and precision (force unit, length unit, number format, decimal places)
plugins.notes: The doc deliberately links no single endpoint because the tool spans 100+ guided model-data endpoints plus all built-in result tables; a REST re-implementation would target the whole /db/* and /post/* surface. Output includes a Contents & Export Log sheet, unit-bearing headers, AutoFilter and text-preserved IDs; failed Jobs are logged without discarding successful ones.

plugins.name: Skew Grillage Geometry Generator
plugins.purpose: Parametrically generates skew grillage geometry (nodes and beam elements, with longitudinal girders split at every cross-member and automatic end crossbeams) into a live CIVIL NX model.
key_inputs: Span, deck width, number of longitudinal girders, transverse spacing
Skew angle (slider or direct entry, -60 to +60 degrees)
Cross-member orientation (Parallel to skew / Perpendicular to girders)
Material ID, longitudinal and transverse section IDs, first node ID, first element ID
plugins.notes: Parametric geometry generation plus /db writes; all four endpoints are cross-linked. Includes start-ID collision checks, a second confirmation when the model already contains nodes or elements, automatic creation of missing materials and sections in the model unit system, rollback of newly created nodes if element write fails, and JSON payload download for review.

plugins.name: CS454 Load Assessment Combinations
plugins.purpose: Generates the full CS 454 Appendix A Table A.1 ULS and SLS assessment combination set with envelopes by mapping model load cases to CS 454 actions and committing them to CIVIL NX.
key_inputs: Connection / Read Model Validation (structure form, load cases, cast iron handling)
Load Cases & Mapping (CS 454 Table A.1 action per active case; live load model and assessment level per moving load case)
Partial factors gamma_fL adverse / relieving per action, gamma_f3 inclusion or resistance-check deferral
Groups & Relations (category behaviour together / independent / exclusive, cross-category exclude or require, permanent load groups adverse / relieving / both, envelope sub-combination merging)
Commit (target table, existing combination handling, name conflict prefix, envelope recording per family)
plugins.notes: Deterministic combination generation plus a /db/LCOM-GEN write, cross-linked. Unmapped load cases block generation rather than defaulting silently; Prestress cases are rejected as CS 455 scope; masonry arch is out of scope; cast iron structures switch to allowable-stress assessment per Section 8 with SLS scope disabled; names are human-readable (e.g. ULS2-ALL1s-W2-Adv) and the preview lists the governing clause for every term.

plugins.name: CS454 Moving Load Generator
plugins.purpose: Generates the CS 454 Appendix B Table B.1 vehicle models (22 vehicles plus fire engine and special vehicle groups) and their moving load cases against traffic lanes already defined in the model.
key_inputs: Model tab (Read model; traffic lanes, vehicles and existing moving load cases; payload template vehicle and load case selection)
Loading (normal / abnormal traffic, ALL model 1 and ALL model 2, assessment load levels with level stacking, individual vehicle de-selection, single vehicle / convoy / both)
Lanes (traffic lane assignment per generated case, remaining-area lane per Clause 5.16, straddling lane pairs, special vehicle type and generated names)
Name pattern tokens and duplicate handling (append / overwrite / skip)
Factors (surface and traffic-stream category, dynamic amplification, critical and other axle impact factors, overload, units, vehicle speed, limit state, combination 1/2/3)
Preview (vehicles with axle data and cases with clause notes)
Generate (Preview payload, Write to model, Diagnostics)
plugins.notes: Moving load generation (no dedicated enum category for moving loads; recorded as other) plus /db/MVHL and /db/MVLD writes, both cross-linked. Traffic lanes must already exist in MIDAS — the plugin only assigns them. New items are created by cloning existing model items to preserve field nesting and enum spelling, falling back to an embedded CS 454 template; names and descriptions exceeding MIDAS field limits are truncated and reported in Preview.

plugins.name: CS454 Auto Lane Generator
plugins.purpose: Computes and creates the CS 454 assessment traffic lanes (ALL Model 1 3.0 m and 2.5 m convoy lanes, ALL Model 2 C/nn lanes, footways, accidental vehicle and CS 458 special vehicle lanes) with correct eccentricities and Lane Items.
key_inputs: Connection / Read model (nodes, elements, structure groups, sections, existing lanes, units, moving load code)
Reference line (proposed line, element range entry, node picking, existing beam reuse, minimum radius reporting)
Lane set checkboxes (ALL Model 1 situations, ALL Model 2, single axle, footway, accidental load, CS 458 special vehicle, HB vehicle, special vehicle combination)
Carriageway width and offset from reference line to left kerb, assessment live load level
Special vehicle width and position in the combination, alignment kerb
Load transfer method (Lane element / Cross beam distribution) and skew angle
plugins.notes: Lane arithmetic plus a /db/LLAN write, cross-linked. Handles the three coexisting lane systems with colour-separated drawings, Equation 5.18 and its table exceptions, remaining-area Clause 5.16.1 exemptions, CS 458 special vehicle placement beside normal traffic, and the Appendix B wheel spacing of 1.8 m shown alongside the 0.6 m value MIDAS stores. Special vehicle width cannot be derived automatically and must be entered each run; deletion must use exact re-queried keys because name filters make the API clear the whole table; skew angle is only available with Cross beam distribution.

plugins.name: Eurocode Auto Lane Generator
plugins.purpose: Applies EN 1991-2 Table 4.1 notional lane rules for road, fatigue and railway loading to compute and create traffic lanes with code-correct wheel spacing and eccentricities.
key_inputs: Read model (nodes, elements, structure groups, sections, existing lanes, units, moving load code)
Reference line selection (proposed line, element range, node picking) or generation of a 10x10 mm dummy reference beam
Carriageway width between kerbs, offset from reference line to left kerb, verge and footway widths
Load group or individual load model selection (gr1a, gr1b, gr3, gr4, gr5; Load Models 1-4; footway; fatigue; railway)
Load transfer method (Lane element / Cross beam distribution) and skew angle
plugins.notes: Lane arithmetic plus a /db/LLAN write, cross-linked. Table 4.1 boundary values are handled exactly (5.399 m gives one 3.0 m lane plus remaining area, 5.4 m gives two 2.7 m lanes); tandem wheel spacing is 2.0 m per EN 1991-2 Figure 4.2b rather than the MIDAS default 1.8 m; rail eccentricity (gauge/18 = 0.080 m for standard gauge) is displayed but deliberately not applied to lanes because MIDAS already accounts for it on the vehicle. Deletion must use exact keys because the API ignores name filters.

plugins.name: Eurocode Load Combinations Plugin
plugins.purpose: Automatically assembles EN 1990 and bridge Annex A2 load combinations in the model, with bridge-type psi tables, automatic group and relation construction and Annex A2 cross-category constraints.
key_inputs: Model load cases and their mapped load types
Bridge type for psi table selection (road Table A2.1 / footway A2.2 / railway A2.3)
plugins.notes: The article is written as a v2.0.0 release note rather than a GUI walkthrough, so no screen-by-screen usage steps are recorded. Combination logic was verified against EN 1990 (9 suites, 175 assertions across expressions 6.10, 6.10a, 6.10b, characteristic, frequent, quasi-permanent, 6.11 and 6.12) but the commit path itself was NOT validated against a real MIDAS model. Envelope is supported only in the General Load Combination table and rejected in design tables; 6.10b xi is fixed at 1.0; fatigue combinations are not generated; only Eurocode moving load cases are recognised; railway models are auto-detected but footbridges must be selected manually.

plugins.name: Eurocode Moving Load Case Generator
plugins.purpose: Generates EN 1991-2 vehicles and moving load cases (Load Models 1-4, footway, FLM1-4 fatigue, LM71 / SW / HSLM railway) from traffic load groups, assigning lane roles and nominal lane numbers.
key_inputs: Model tab (Read model: moving load code, traffic lanes, existing vehicles and cases)
Load models tab (EN 1991-2 items and traffic load groups; per-load-model case generation option)
Lanes tab (role per lane: road / footway / remaining area / railway; remaining-area loading; MIDAS lane optimisation)

Factors tab (NDP preset, tandem and UDL adjustment factors per nominal lane, remaining-area factor, LM2 betaQ, LM3 special vehicle set, psi combination factors, railway classification factor and Railway Bridge Data, representative value set)
Generate (Dry run or Write to model)
plugins.notes: Moving load generation (no dedicated enum category for moving loads; recorded as other) plus /db/MVHL and /db/MVLDeu writes, both cross-linked. FLM5 is not generated (no standard axle load set); gr2 (braking, acceleration, centrifugal) is classified as static and not generated; railway cases require a Track-role lane or generation is refused; psi0 is not requested because MIDAS applies 0.8 automatically; models whose moving load code is not Eurocode are refused.

plugins.name: Load Combination Contribution Analyzer
plugins.purpose: Decomposes a load combination (including nested sub-combinations and envelopes) into signed per-load-case contributions at every result location and verifies the re-summed values against what CIVIL NX reports.
key_inputs: Combination selection (all LCOM table entries, with a combination tree)
Result table (Beam, Truss, Plate, Plane Stress, Plane Strain, Axisymmetric, Solid, Link; force or stress; local or global axis)
Select elements by structure group, boundary group, section, thickness, material or element type (each with element counts), plus manual element ranges
Results tab filters (Element, Part, Component, Sense)
plugins.notes: Read-only post-processing over analysis results; only /db/LCOM-GEN is cross-linked (as an inferred combination-tree source) and the element result-table endpoints actually used are not identified in the doc. Requests 9-significant-digit precision rather than display precision and aborts without an override if re-summation differs from the CIVIL NX reported value beyond tolerance. Rejects nonlinear / pushover, creep and shrinkage, tendon primary and secondary effects, time-history results and derived quantities (von Mises, principal stresses) because they are not linear in the load cases. Effective factors for cases reachable by multiple paths are the sum of the per-path factor products.
